history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take measures to ensure that the senior managers’ compacts are duly signed in a timely manner for their proper functioning as a performance management tool.
history.administration_response: Significant progress has been made in improving the timeliness of establishing senior managers’ compacts. The Business Transformation and Accountability Division and the Executive Office of the Secretary-General launched the 2023 compact drafting exercise on 4 January 2023 (as opposed to 1 February 2022 for the 2022 exercise) and collaborated closely to provide support to entities. This work resulted in 87 per cent of 2023 compacts endorsed by the Secretary-General by 9 March 2023, compared with only 32 per cent of 2022 compacts endorsed by 28 April 2022. The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that progress has been achieved with regard to the signing of senior managers’ compacts, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
